verdict.rationale: The docs offer no dedicated export feature. Some data could still be pulled out programmatically: the API has a paginated, filterable subscriber search endpoint (GET /fetch/search), broadcast history is readable via the API, and the CLI and SDKs claim to manage the entire account. Assembling a full export would be a do-it-yourself scripting job, and the only mention of leaving is 'Cancel anytime'. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all account data, explicit open formats (e.g. CSV or JSON dumps), export coverage for events, workflows, sequences, templates and forms, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete export-and-leave path.
